description.text: Program Description Industrial design major students mainly learn basic theories and knowledge of industrial design, with application of modelling design principle and law of the modelling of all kinds of products with colour, form and appearance, structure and function, shape, structure and material and technology, product and people, product and environment, the relationship between the market, and the unified expression of these relationships in the modelling design of the products of basic skills. Future Career Students can be engaged in mechanical and electrical products, daily products appearance design, can also be engaged in graphic advertising, VIS, product packaging, indoor decoration design work. Duration 4 years

duration.text: The Industrial Design at Beihang University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3472 USD/per year ￥ 25000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record.

requirements.text: 1.Applicants are expected to study hard, observe the Chinese laws and the regulations of BUAA and have the equivalent of a high school education. 2.Applicants are expected to have good scores and studied hard in high school. 3.Applicants should be under thirty five years old in general. 4.Applicants should attend the entrance examination and meet the requirements of BUAA.
